draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base holds on the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains it was trained on.
rationale: Evidence (T1.r1, T1.r2) shows Wrenfold beats Fennick-Base on unseen test sets of Banking and Travel, the same domains used in training. No evaluation on other customer-service domains exists, so generalization beyond trained domains is unsupported; the claim should be narrowed to the evaluated domains.
